hero.title: The Africa Waste Observatory
hero.subtitle: Advancing Sustainable Waste Management in Africa
hero.description: Africa faces a rapidly escalating waste challenge driven by urbanization, population growth, economic development, and changing consumption patterns. Waste types now span solid, liquid, and gaseous streams, each posing complex environmental, public health, and socioeconomic risks. Without accurate, harmonized data, governments, investors, researchers, and communities are unable to plan, finance, and implement effective waste and pollution management systems. The Africa Waste Observatory (AWO) serves as a central hub for consolidated continental waste data, performance indicators, and transformative strategies to drive a cleaner, healthier, and circular Africa.

challenge.title: The Waste Challenge in Africa
challenge.coverage: Low waste collection and treatment coverage, especially in informal, peri-urban, and rural areas.
challenge.enforcement: Weak enforcement of waste, water, and emissions regulations.
challenge.recycling: Limited recycling, wastewater treatment, and gaseous emissions controls.
challenge.data: Severe lack of accurate, comparable waste and emissions data continent-wide.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.intro: Our mission is to collect, analyze, and disseminate critical information on waste generation, composition, treatment, and disposal practices across Africa. By providing accessible and reliable data, we aim to:
mission.item1: Support informed decision-making by equipping governments and organizations with evidence-based insights to develop effective waste management policies and strategies.
mission.item2: Promote Best Practices by highlighting sustainable waste reduction, recycling, and recovery initiatives that can be replicated and scaled across the continent.
mission.item3: Foster Collaboration by creating a network of stakeholders, including researchers, policymakers, industry leaders, and local communities, to drive collective action towards sustainable waste management.
mission.item4: Raise Awareness by educating the public on the environmental, social, and economic impacts of waste, encouraging responsible consumption and disposal behaviors.
mission.closing: We believe that a well-informed continent is a powerful continent, capable of tackling its most pressing environmental challenges.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.intro: We envision an Africa where waste is viewed as a resource, not a burden. A continent where innovative waste management solutions drive economic growth, protect public health, and preserve natural ecosystems. Our long-term vision includes:
vision.item1: Zero Waste Communities by supporting the development of urban and rural areas that minimize waste generation and maximize resource recovery.
vision.item2: Circular Economy Hub by positioning Africa as a leader in circular economy principles, creating value from waste materials and reducing reliance on virgin resources.
vision.item3: Data-Driven Innovation by becoming the go-to source for data that fuels research, technology development, and entrepreneurial solutions in waste management.
vision.item4: Environmental Resilience by contributing to climate change mitigation and adaptation efforts by reducing landfill emissions and promoting greener waste management practices.
vision.closing: Through continuous research, stakeholder engagement, and strategic partnerships, we are committed to making this vision a reality for every African nation.

why.title: Why We Exist
why.text: Effective waste management depends on accurate data and informed decision-making. Across Africa, data is often fragmented, outdated, or inconsistent, making it difficult to allocate resources, design effective policies, or measure progress. AWO was created to fill this critical gap.

objectives.title: Core Objectives
objectives.item1: Improve waste management systems (solid, liquid, gaseous).
objectives.item2: Promote integrated waste management based on the hierarchy: reduce, reuse, recycle, treat, dispose.
objectives.item3: Support evidence-based policies and investment plans.
objectives.item4: Guide financial institutions on sustainable infrastructure.

meta.title: Privacy Policy - Africa Waste Observatory
meta.description: Learn how the Africa Waste Observatory collects, uses, and protects information when you visit our platform.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains how we handle information when you visit the Africa Waste Observatory.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.p1: The Africa Waste Observatory is a UK-registered technology startup dedicated to tracking, managing, and transforming waste data intelligence across the African continent.
intro.p2: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect information when you access and interact with our website. We are committed to transparency and to respecting your privacy.

analytics.title: 2.1 Analytics Data (Google Analytics)
analytics.desc: We use Google Analytics (measurement ID: G-QVHZ3Q6F0J) to understand how visitors interact with our website. Google Analytics may collect:
items: Pages visited and time spent on each page
Referring website or source that brought you to our site
Approximate geographic location (country/city level, derived from IP address)
Browser type, device type, and operating system
analytics.footer: This data is aggregated and anonymized. We do not use Google Analytics to identify individual visitors. Google's use of this data is governed by the Google Privacy Policy.

localStorage.title: 2.2 Local Storage
localStorage.desc: We use your browser's localStorage to save your language preference (English or French) so that it persists between visits. This data:
items: Is stored only on your device
Is never transmitted to our servers or any third party
Can be cleared at any time through your browser settings

notCollected.title: 2.3 Information We Do Not Collect
items: Require user registration or account creation
Collect personal information such as your name, email address, or phone number without explicit consent
Use invasive tracking scripts or commercial advertising networks

cookies.title: 3. Cookies
cookies.p1: This website itself does not set cookies. However, Google Analytics may set cookies (such as _ga and _gid) in your browser to distinguish unique visitors and throttle request rates. These are first-party cookies managed by Google's analytics script.
cookies.p2: You can control or block cookies through your browser settings. Blocking these cookies will not affect the core functionality of the website — all content will remain fully accessible.

use.title: 4. How We Use Information
use.desc: The aggregated analytics data we receive is used solely to:
items: Understand which content and research resources are most useful to visitors
Identify opportunities to improve the website's structure and navigation
Monitor general traffic patterns and continental reach
Inform data-driven intelligence and reporting on waste management across Africa
use.closing: We do not sell, rent, or share any data with third parties for commercial purposes.

thirdParty.title: 5. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.desc: Our website utilizes the following trusted third-party services:

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.p: Google Analytics data retention is configured according to Google's standard retention cycles (typically 26 months). After this period, aggregated analytics data is automatically deleted. Your language preference stored in localStorage persists until you clear your browser data.

children.title: 7. Children's Privacy
children.p: The Africa Waste Observatory is an educational and public intelligence resource suitable for all audiences. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children or any other visitors. Because no personal information is collected through the site, no special provisions for children's data are required.

rights.title: 8. Your Rights
rights.desc: As a visitor to this website, you have the right to:

items.title: Opt out of Google Analytics
items.desc: Install the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

items.title: Block cookies
items.desc: Configure your browser to block third-party cookies or all cookies.

items.title: Clear local storage
items.desc: Remove your saved language preference through your browser's settings or developer tools.

items.title: Request information
items.desc: Contact us to ask about our data protection and usage practices.

links.title: 9. External Links
links.p: Our website contains links to external resources, references, and innovation initiatives. These links open in new tabs and are provided for informational and research purposes. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of external websites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any external site you visit.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.p: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices or for operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Any updates will be published directly on this page with a revised effective date. We encourage you to review this page periodically.
